skills.description: Through fixed aquarium cameras, the system analyzes fish behavior near the water surface, detecting repeated mouth-out-of-water (gasping), rapid mouth opening/closing (fast respiration) and exaggerated operculum (gill cover) movement — classic symptoms of hypoxia or poisoning. When multiple fish exhibit the above behavior simultaneously and the duration exceeds a configurable threshold (default 60 seconds), the system outputs an 'ammonia poisoning or hypoxia risk warning', prompting the user to immediately test water quality, perform water change, or increase aeration. This skill helps take emergency action BEFORE fish die. Application scenarios: home aquariums, public aquariums, aquaculture ponds. The system monitors in real time and pushes alerts the moment fish gasping is detected. Skill features: ammonia poisoning is a common acute emergency in aquariums — by the time it is noticed, fish deaths may have already occurred. AI-based automatic recognition of gasping and abnormal respiration provides emergency warning at the earliest stage, buying time to handle the situation and reduce losses. skills.description: 把"用户需求 → 第一性原理拆解 → 构建 → 验证 → 发布 → 评测优化 → 隐性需求回流"串成单一全生命周期编排工作流，内置 Loop Engineering 验证纪律作为构建产物质量门，决策权始终在用户。
skills.description_zh:
内置 Loop Engineering 验证纪律（见步骤 3.5 与文末附录 A）：构建阶段后强制用「定标→最小→验证→循环」闭环验证产物，并以「置信度由验证反推、禁止自评」为质量铁律，确保 flow 产出的 skill 是"验证通过"而非"写完即完"。
把"用户需求 → 第一性原理拆解 → 找 GitHub 高星项目 → 拆解对比 → 版本演化 → 出选项 → 构建目标 skill → 发布到 SkillHub → 取回评测优化 → 隐性需求回流"
串成单一全生命周期工作流。编排 need-to-skill-decoder（拆解）、skill-builder（构建）、
skillhub-publisher（发布）、workbuddy-conversation-miner（隐性需求回流）、skill-evolve-pipeline（评测驱动优化）五个 skill 协作。

触发场景（满足任一即触发）：
1. 用户说"把我的需求端到端变成 skill 并发布优化"、"从想法到上线的 skill 跑一遍"
2. 用户描述一个需求，希望先分析+找参考，再直接落地、发布、持续优化（一气呵成）
3. 用户希望"解码器/构建器/发布器/优化流水线"联动，而不是手动分多步跑
4. 已发布的 skill 拿到评测，用户说"用 flow 优化它" → 直接进 Phase C（评测+优化闭环）

核心价值：用一个编排层把五个 skill 黏成一条从需求到上线的闭环，协作靠落盘契约
（SPEC.md / 两块看板 / _RECURRING.json），决策权始终在用户（选项阶段、发布动作不替用户拍板）。

不用于：
- 只想分析需求、不想落地 → 直接用 need-to-skill-decoder
- 已经有一份规格文档、只想构建 → 直接用 skill-builder
- 纯发布无优化 → 直接用 skillhub-publisher
- 纯本地小改、不取评测不发版 → 直接用 skill-evolution-orchestrator
skills.name: 需求到技能流水线
